selection.english_voice_note: Fresh English uses a previously unused German-primary multilingual voice with English requested.
selection.long_supplement: The existing Spanish 142.88-second recording and longest English 252.08-second recording. Fixed before any smoothed-vocoder held-out output labels. Sources reused across methods; not newly generated voices or independent additions to the project corpus.

asr.method: Native long-form timestamp decoding; no artificial segment word cuts
asr.known_language: Fresh requests and explicit public language metadata; otherwise original automatic detection, reused for output
asr.normalization: Whisper BasicTextNormalizer(remove_diacritics=False), NFKC; Chinese/Japanese CER, otherwise whitespace WER
asr.limitation: Recognizer output is an estimate; paired disagreements do not prove changed speech or unchanged speech.
asr.padding_policy: Waveform padded to at least 30 seconds at 16kHz; complete longer audio untruncated; attention mask supplied

secondary_asr.method: Native long-form timestamp decoding; no artificial segment word cuts
secondary_asr.known_language: Fresh requests and explicit public language metadata; otherwise original automatic detection, reused for output
secondary_asr.normalization: Whisper BasicTextNormalizer(remove_diacritics=False), NFKC; Chinese/Japanese CER, otherwise whitespace WER
secondary_asr.limitation: Recognizer output is an estimate; paired disagreements do not prove changed speech or unchanged speech.
secondary_asr.padding_policy: Waveform padded to at least 30 seconds at 16kHz; complete longer audio untruncated; attention mask supplied

speaker.limitation: Descriptive embedding cosine; no calibrated speaker identity or listening guarantee

official_source_parity.purpose: Local implementation parity probe only; two-second authored excerpt never uploaded to a detector.

verification_cli_smoke.interpretation: Integration smoke test on a spent generated fixture; excluded from held-out and removal denominators.

runtime.scope: Controlled local CPU runtime only; no detector requests or removal claims

fixture.provenance: Four-second excerpt of authored synthetic speech; used only for runtime measurement, never submitted as a shortened detector case.

runtime.limits: One machine and short mono excerpt; two warm observations per method. Not a throughput or quality guarantee for longer, stereo, or arbitrary audio.

fixed_fallback_workflow.decision_rule: Keep the exact primary FLAC if its response is negative; otherwise try full-flow boundary-safe, then strong boundary-safe, preserving whole-file PCM24 FLAC encoding before each query. Stop at the first negative; publish no verified file on errors or all-positive results. No tuning from fresh processed labels.
fixed_fallback_workflow.repeat_handling: Any positive primary response, including an exact-file repeat, triggers the fixed fallback order. Repeated responses are not independent recordings.
fixed_fallback_workflow.interpretation: Same source recordings; fallback queries do not increase the sample count. Top-level speech metrics describe the primary candidate. Selected-output metrics use exact-byte-bound fallback measurements for replaced files.

interpretation: Frozen whole-file measurements. Controls, prior development cases, and repeated queries do not inflate removal counts. No claim of universal erasure, unchanged words, or later endpoint behavior.
